final_message:
`BRIEFING.md` is written (no commit made, per instructions). It covers all 120 Q2 transactions, converts non-EUR amounts using `rates.csv` (rounding each transaction to the cent before summing), and cross-checks category totals against `budget.yaml`.

Key findings: total Q2 spend was €44,023.75, with monthly spend accelerating (+9.8% May, +10.0% June). Travel and software are over budget (17.8% and 18.3% respectively) — travel driven by a June spike in taxis/car rentals, software front-loaded by April license renewals.
